notes: After you say YES you get one short message, like "Published: <link>" with a picture of the page, not two. No request numbers (like A4) unless several things are waiting. When you ask for a logo or a design, it makes a real logo (and uses it in the site) instead of a placeholder, and "Again, I need…" is treated as the main request. Tool commands that one AI key sometimes wrote as text are now run properly, and that text never reaches your chat. Pages are checked for broken or borrowed pictures before you see them or are asked for YES, and a "designed" page gets a real layout, its own logo and the buttons you asked for.
